description:
SIGNUM HQ 1.10 brings My Watchlist to the iPhone Home Screen.

What is new (version 1.10 is live on the App Store):
- Home Screen widgets in small, medium and large sizes. Each stock on the watchlist shows its price; the medium and large widgets also show where the price sits between its put floor, max pain and call wall, without opening the app.
- My Watchlist keeps its prices refreshed inside the app.
- Adding a stock takes one tap on the gold heart. The list is stored on the device and needs no account.
- App interface in English, Korean and Japanese; App Store pages in 12 languages.

Objective: make the watchlist a daily glance for people who follow US stocks, including investors in Korea and Japan who follow the US session during their night.

The In-App Events "My Watchlist" and "Widgets launch 1.10.0" (both Major Update) are published.
notes:
Priority: high. Home Screen widgets are the headline feature of 1.10 and extend My Watchlist (launched Sep 29; our KR/JP nomination covers the watchlist itself).
Timing: 1.10 is live on the App Store; the proposed window, Oct 21 to Dec 31, keeps the 3-week lead time.
Privacy: the watchlist stays on the device; no sign-up.
